prompts.English: Letter from a merchant requesting payment for goods shipped from Fustat to Alexandria, mentioning the price of pepper and indigo.

prompts.English: Fragment of a literary text containing a commentary on Genesis, possibly from the school of Saadia Gaon.

prompts.English: List of household goods and their values, possibly part of a dowry or estate inventory from 11th-century Egypt.
